name: Kushima (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Kushima city emblem in white: a ring with a winged top and a stylised device of angular strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Kushima, a city in Miyazaki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 13 July 1955.

features.role: Kushima city emblem — a ring with a winged top and a stylised device of angular strokes
